doctrine.note: KandyDrops code organization protects source-truth hierarchy, small self-contained change surfaces, affected validation, deterministic cacheability, and compact agent context before broad audits or route moves.

misplacedFeatureLogicInSrcLib.classification: src/lib feature logic: wallet, drops, chat

missingFeatureOwnership.migrationReason: Wallet, PayPal, GumDrop ledger, and paid-source truth should have one feature owner.
Drop discovery, preview, unlock, and entitlement UI need one migration lane.
Viewer file continuity and watch sessions should colocate under viewer ownership.
Public creator profile projection should be separate from creator dashboard operations.
Creator operations and paid experience server truth need a dedicated feature owner.
Chat shell, viewport, and message-state logic should not sprawl across shared primitives.
Support and bug-report user facts need one user/admin split owner.
Moderation evidence, score, and admin display must stay evidence-weighted.
Notification read truth and UI diagnostics should not fragment across hooks/components.
Admin user metrics need one hot-cache and source-state owner.
Analytics contracts, ingestion, normalization, and admin projections need one ownership map.
Behavioral inputs and recommendation scoring should be separated from UI panels.

guardrails: Server purchase facts stay in server modules.
Client begin_checkout remains funnel context only.
Locked content URLs stay out of pre-unlock UI.
Unlock metrics come from server entitlement truth.
Telemetry must not include internal content URLs.
File views connect to watch-session facts.
Fan actions target creators without becoming creator behavior.
Paid-source spend rules stay server-truth first.
Expected booking failures use typed safe errors.
Chat owns its stable viewport shell.
Diagnostics cannot block input focus paths.
Admin support actions stay excluded from user behavior.
Permission errors feed debug evidence.
Browser screenshot heuristics cannot be confirmed facts.
Weak signals stay contextual.
notification_read is the behavioral fact.
Opened/clicked events are diagnostics unless promoted.
Admin/projection facts never contaminate user metrics.
Cards expose live/cached/stale/error state.
Actor and target ids remain separate.
Client-only events cannot anchor revenue or unlock metrics.
Deterministic ranking remains baseline.
ML promotion needs validator-backed evidence.

routeGroupMigrationPlan: Do not move routes automatically; create route groups only in owner-approved migration slices.
src/app/(public): route group target for organizational grouping without URL changes.
src/app/(auth): route group target for organizational grouping without URL changes.
src/app/(user): route group target for organizational grouping without URL changes.
src/app/(creator): route group target for organizational grouping without URL changes.
src/app/(admin): route group target for organizational grouping without URL changes.
src/app/(system): route group target for organizational grouping without URL changes.
Route moves require parity checks for URL, metadata, auth, telemetry, and adjacent validators before merge.
minimalCommands: npm run typecheck if TypeScript changed
summary: KandyDrops code organization protects source-truth hierarchy, small self-contained change surfaces, affected validation, deterministic cacheability, and compact agent context before broad audits or route moves. Current report scored 10/100 with 732 organization findings; report arrays are capped for compact agent loading.
